mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at, p.category_id, p.audit_status, p.like_count, c.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ',') AS tag_names FROM post p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id AND t.status = 1 WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id AND c.status = 1 WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.created_at, p.category_id, p.audit_status, p.like_count, c.name AS category_name, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ',') AS tag_names FROM post p JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id AND c.status = 1 LEFT JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id AND t.status = 1 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 1 AND p.audit_status = 1 GROUP BY p.id
SELECT id, user_id, category_id, title, content, status, audit_status, audit_reason, audit_updated_at, like_count, created_at, updated_at FROM post WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, category_id, title, content, status, audit_status, audit_reason, audit_updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditReason}, #{auditUpdatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_reason = #{auditReason}, audit_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
